input.detail:
## Event log (Phase 2)

- `.ambiflex/log.jsonl`: one JSON line per change (`goal`, `upsert`, `merge`, `auto`), append-only, with the session id and a timestamp. `.ambiflex/.gitattributes` sets `merge=union` so two sessions' logs merge without conflicts.
- `replay(events)` rebuilds the tree in time order. When two sessions created the same id offline, the later one is renamed (`n7-b`) and that session's later references follow.
- `tree.json` stays as a derived snapshot (readable, synced to the mobile page). Cost is only in the snapshot.
- Migration: a session that finds a `tree.json` but no log converts it once (`eventsFromSnapshot`).

Judge: `claude plugin test` 25/25, migration script round trip `true`.
input.verification: claude plugin test: 25 pass (replay equals state, union of two divergent logs recovers both subtrees with renamed collisions, snapshot migration round-trips); real tree.json migrated to log.jsonl with an exact round trip

input.title: Tree search
input.summary: Like a chess engine: N subagents in parallel on N tracks, each in its branch, scored by its declared judge; prune the weak, merge the best. Budget shown before launch.

input.title: Calibrated estimates
input.summary: Three-point estimates (o/p/pess), critical path (done), arrival date in the header, calibration factor applied to new estimates (measured; the ×0.03 artefact from hand-set timestamps must be excluded).

input.title: Nodes ↔ branches ↔ PR
input.summary: One track = one branch or worktree; a node shows its commits and PR; "Validate" on a node with a PR proposes the merge (never merges alone).

input.title: Adoption strategy
input.summary: Umbrella for n10-n15: settled when its children are. The plugin now treats goal nodes as umbrellas (their children are workable while they stay open) and works the plan in the order it was written.

input.title: Proof before promo
input.summary: No launch without a real measured demo: a project run with 3 tracks in parallel, estimated vs actual time, a 60-second video. Needs calibrated estimates (n5) first.

input.detail:
## Calibrated estimates (Phase 3)

- Three-point estimates `1h/2h/4h` (optimistic / likely / pessimistic): expected value (o + 4p + pess) / 6, spread (pess − o) / 6. Single values still work.
- Calibration = median of actual / estimated over finished nodes, counting only real measurements: ≥ 2 min of work on an estimate ≥ 30 min, ratio within [0.05, 20]. The ×0.03 artefact from hand-set timestamps is now excluded.
- Expected end: the calibrated critical path turned into a calendar date (8h days, Monday to Friday; around the clock in auto mode), with ± from the three-point spread. Shown in the panel, in `tree_get` and when auto mode starts.
- The method tells Claude to multiply new estimates by the reported calibration factor.

Judge: `claude plugin test` 28/28.
input.verification: claude plugin test: 28 pass (PERT value and spread of "1h/2h/4h", calibration rejects hand-set timestamps and keeps a 3h-on-2h measurement at ×1.5, arrival skips nights and weekends unless continuous)

input.detail:
## Nodes ↔ branches ↔ PR (Phase 4)

- An agent spawned with `#<id>` gets that node its own branch `ambiflex/<id>-<slug>` in a worktree under `.ambiflex/worktrees/<id>` (git-ignored); the agent is told to work and commit there, never on the main checkout.
- The panel shows, per node with a branch, its commits beyond `main` and its PR when `gh` can report one; the Git tab refreshes them after every git command.
- "Validate" on a node with a branch asks Claude to propose the merge of that branch (or its PR) and never to merge without explicit confirmation.

Judge: `claude plugin test` 29/29 and a real-repo run of the worktree commands.
input.verification: claude plugin test: 29 pass (an agent spawned for #n1 gets `git worktree add .ambiflex/worktrees/n1 -b ambiflex/n1-perf-track`, its prompt names the worktree, the node records the branch and the panel shows it); the same git commands verified on a real temporary repository (worktree, commit, `git log main..branch` lists it)

input.detail:
## Tree search (Phase 5)

- `tree_explore <parent>`: one subagent per proposed child track, in parallel, each in its own worktree branch, with the budget (agents × minutes) echoed before launch. Each agent is told to end with `NODE:` / `RESULT:` / `SCORE:` measured by the track's declared judge.
- Scores land on the nodes as the agents finish (matched by agent id, or by the NODE line on hosts that do not name agents); the nodes move to *needs review*.
- `tree_prune <parent>`: keeps the best-scored track, abandons the others with the reason. The panel ranks the tracks and offers *Prune weak* and *Merge best*.
- Real run: demo/parse.js, baseline 334 ms. Shaped rows (7×) beat single pass (4-7×) and no-spread (3×). Merged: 44 ms on main.

Judge: the independent benchmark on the merged code, and 31 tests.
input.verification: End-to-end run on a real problem: tree_explore spawned 3 agents in their own worktree branches, each reported NODE/RESULT/SCORE through its judge, scores landed on the nodes automatically, tree_prune kept the best, the winner merged into the main branch benches at 7.38× (independent measurement); plus 31 unit tests
